verdict.rationale: First-party docs show a workflow for generating a Convertible Note in-platform. Workflows generate documents for execution on the platform, and signers get an emailed link and can draw, upload, or type a signature. The cap table is described as auto-updating and smart-linked to completed documents, so the note plausibly lands on the cap table. Missing for 10: any evidence of SAFE support, explicit modeling of conversion terms (discount, cap, conversion into a future round) beyond generic hypothetical-round scenario modeling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
